title: Apple Releases Xcode 27.1 Beta With iPhone Duo Support
content:
Apple today released the first Xcode 27.1 beta. The latest version of the tool adds support for iPhone Duo app development.

Available on Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26.6 or later, Xcode 27.1 includes updated SDKs for the iPhone Duo, and a simulator that supports the device's new poses and orientations.
